title: Publish genuine paper runtime bridge and causal lag observations

root_cause_analysis.bridge_identity_absence: PaperFleetReconciler._build_worker_env previously omitted forwarding verified engine bridge and context metadata from binding / binding.metadata, resulting in worker runtime context loaded: false and bridge reporting degraded in owner evaluation.
root_cause_analysis.context_bootstrap: PaperRuntimeService did not initialize PantheonRuntimeContext from manifest or environment when runtime_context was not explicitly injected, preventing fallback telemetry from accessing bridge attributes.
root_cause_analysis.causal_lag_absence: PaperRuntimeService did not measure causal queue lag from incoming signal enqueue timestamps, leaving queue_lag_ms unobserved; RuntimeTelemetryEmitter did not record genuine HTTP delivery latency, leaving delivery_lag_ms / event_delivery_lag_ms absent.

remediation.paper_fleet_reconciler: In _build_worker_env, forward verified bridge and context environment variables (PANTHEON_ENGINE_BRIDGE_REMOTE, PANTHEON_ENGINE_BRIDGE_REPO, PANTHEON_ENGINE_BRIDGE_SOURCE_PATH, PANTHEON_ENGINE_BRIDGE_PATH, PANTHEON_ENGINE_BRIDGE_COMMIT, PANTHEON_RUNTIME_ADAPTER_VERSION, PANTHEON_ARTIFACT_CHECKSUM, PANTHEON_STRATEGY_ID, PANTHEON_RUNTIME_ROLE, PANTHEON_CONTEXT_SOURCE) from binding and binding.metadata when non-empty.
remediation.runtime_context: In _normalize_payload, support fallback extraction from nested metadata for artifact, capital, bridge, trace, and runtime_role; accept PANTHEON_ENGINE_BRIDGE_REPO as fallback in from_env.
remediation.telemetry_emitter: Record monotonic roundtrip elapsed time across urllib.request.urlopen in emit_payload as last_delivery_lag_ms; expose in snapshot; support extra_metrics in emit_heartbeat; extract bridge metadata from binding.metadata in _base_metadata.
remediation.paper_runtime: Initialize PantheonRuntimeContext from manifest/env if omitted in PaperRuntimeService; measure causal queue lag (now - enqueued_at) on signal_generation order events; expose queue_lag_ms, event_delivery_lag_ms, and delivery_lag_ms in snapshot and heartbeats; keep missing/unverifiable timestamps strictly None/degraded without fabrication.

test_results.services/execution/lean_runtime/test_run: 14 passed (including 2 new metadata normalization and bridge fallback tests)

invariants_preserved: Zero financial validator, cash/price arithmetic, or threshold modifications
Missing timestamps and unobserved telemetry delivery remain explicit None/null (degraded state), never faked or defaulted to 0
No external credentials, tokens, or live trading routes altered
